name: Apathy ~Narugami Gakuen Toshi Densetsu Tanteikyoku~
original_name: アパシー 〜鳴神学園都市伝説探偵局〜
source: Saiga Ryuusuke is asked to join a group of people interested in the occult, after which after which a number of legends concerning the town present themselves.
translation: 赛贺龙介受邀加入一个对神秘学感兴趣的团体，此后，数则与城镇有关的传说接连出现在他们面前。
